About this item

reviews_1s:
Poorly made. The mesh is actually too tight. When you want to wash some food the mesh doesn’t allow the water to easily run out and your freshly washed food is sitting in a puddle of water. The frame is flimsy and two of the three units have had the handle break off from where it’s barely welded to the frame of the strainer.This strainer set is sturdy with nice handles and a solid mesh. Unfortunately, they weren't designed by anyone with any common sense. They appear to stack nicely so you can save space on your wall - I assure you, they don't. The loop on the ends are all the same size which means when hung, the strainers don't nicely fit into each other because the thicker metal rims around the mesh end up on top of each other. Hanging them from the handles is even worse.

If the medium strainer loop was 1/4" taller and the small strainer loop was 1/2" taller, these would very nicely stack while hung up. This has become a constant source of frustration as I try to hang up one and it knocks the other off the wall until I pick that one up and end up knocking the other off the wall. Easily foreseeable and avoidable.Low qualityWas fine at first, they seemed very sturdy. The last strainer I owned the mesh started to pull away from the rim so i liked the thicker rim on this one. but after about a year the weld on one side of the handle failed and today the other side failed and the handle complexly disconnected. if you want to replace the large one every year than go ahead and buy this.Cheap stuff, useless, threw them awayI've only had this for a month and used the strainers maybe a total of four times. Today, the handle fell off the mid-sized piece while I was hand washing it. Looking closely, the handles appear to be welded to the sieve portion very weakly. I haven't even tried putting these in the dishwasher yet, but based on what happened with lukewarm sink water, I would strongly advise against it.
